messages:
Maya L: Heads-up from QA: mobile console is flaky when you open a project with >30 model runs. Table rows stack weirdly and the left nav covers action buttons. Seen on iPhone SE and Android emulators.
Jon P: saw it on my Pixel 5 too. Repro steps: Console > Projects > select project with many runs > tap "Runs" tab > tap a run > at ~40s the run list shifts and buttons go under the sidebar. Looks like a combination of long-description cells and the sidebar's position.
Rina S: design thoughts: we currently have a persistent left nav that switches to an overlay at very small widths, but our breakpoint is 600px. I think we should increase the responsive breakpoint to 768px and also make tables horizontally scrollable with a subtle gradient edge to indicate overflow.
Jon P: engineering callouts: pushing content when sidebar toggles is trickier than overlay because toasts and popovers expect the content to be in a certain stacking context. If we push, we'd have to update z-indexs for many components. Overlay is safer but discoverability of the swipe/scroll is the issue.
benji.bot: accessibility scan: ARIA missing on sidebar toggle, table headers not linked with aria-controls on responsive layout, and some interactive elements are <44px on touch.
Maya L: quick wins we can try this sprint: 1) truncate long name fields with ellipsis + tap-to-expand popover; 2) add a 24px right padding on table container so the last action button isn't flush against the edge; 3) add offscreen hint text "Swipe to view more columns" when overflow detected.
Rina S: I mocked two alternatives: A) visible thin scrollbar + gradient hint, B) overlay drawer nav + inline persistent hint. My preference is A for data-heavy views (tables) and B for command-heavy views (settings, billing).
Sam K: pragmatic idea: use JS to add a "scrollable" class only when table.scrollWidth > table.clientWidth. Then show the gradient and hint. Debounce on resize.
Jon P: agree. Also we need to ensure keyboard users can scroll with arrow keys. Use tabindex=0 on the table wrapper and add keydown listeners for arrowLeft/Right to scroll by 150px.
Maya L: could we also make tag chips wrap under the name instead of stretching the column? Might help a lot.
Rina S: yep, tag chips will wrap beneath the title at narrow widths and we'll show a +N counter if >3.
benji.bot: note added: ticket CON-4921 created for mobile/table responsive fixes.
Maya L: timeline: aim to ship truncation + hint + padding this sprint. Rina to handoff mocks by tomorrow noon. Jon to spike scroll detection & key handlers. Sam to run accessibility checklist.
Rina S: will do. I'll include copy for the hint: "Swipe left to reveal hidden columns" and an sr-only line for screen readers.
Jon P: I'll open a WIP PR and add tests for the key handlers.
Maya L: thanks everyone, will follow up in post-merge QA. :rocket:
